fusions.name: Bar Shot
fusions.desc: Fires two weights joined by links at the first enemy it meets that deals 32 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, then whips on to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that.

fusions.name: Grapeshot
fusions.desc: Fires 4 linked slugs in a fan out to 6 tiles, each dealing 6 damage and stunning the target for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Swivel Mount
fusions.desc: Mounts a gun on a chained stand where you stand for 14 seconds. It fires at an enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Belt-Fed
fusions.desc: Each ability you use loads a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 30% in all at 5 stacks, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
